description: This file defines a ColorMap class used for mapping hex color codes to specific internal numeric indices within a PHP spreadsheet writer component, specifically for the XLS format.

classes.name: ColorMap
classes.description: Provides a static mapping from color hex codes to internal color indices for XLS file writing.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Returns the internal color index for a given Color object, or a default index if the color is not in the map.
